description: Self-assessment of an AI system under the EU AI Act from a few answers: prohibited (Article 5), high-risk (Annex III), Article 50 transparency only, minimal risk, or outside the EU. Returns the duties with their dates and the Spurvik setup steps. Not legal advice and not a decision under Article 6.

annexIii.description: Annex III high-risk areas that apply.

inEu.description: Placed on the market or used in the EU.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized questionnaire and Console links.

siteDomain.description: Optional public company domain (for example, personio.de) to prefill report, questionnaire, and Console links.

useCase.description: Optional plain-language system summary (up to 4000 chars, never echoed or stored) as an alternative to structured inEu/annexIii flags.

name: spurvik_classify_ai_act_risk
